title.narrative: BIDV Supporting Sustainable Agriculture and Expanding Access to Finance for Women-Owned Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises Lending Project

description.narrative: Senior unsecured loan to BIDV for $100m of ADB OCR proceeds - 80% ($80m) will support green agriculture; and 20% ($20m) to expand access to finance for women-owned SMEs (WSMEs); up to $20m of concessional loan from CANPA for green agriculture, and $100m of parallel loans from commercial lenders to be arranged by ADB for onlending to WSMEs and SMEs in rural areas.
